== Biography ==
David Glasgow's existing profile gives his birth as 20 July 1744. A Findmypast parish transcript indexes his baptism on 29 July 1744 at Ayr, Ayrshire, and names Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland as his parents.<ref name="FMP">"Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929," Findmypast transcript, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_692915698&tab=this David Glasgow, R_692915698] (reviewed 23 October 2026), baptism 29 July 1744, Ayr; parents Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland. The transcript gives birth year 1744 but no separate birth day. Original register image uninspected.</ref> The transcript does not establish or contradict 20 July as his birth date, which needs a separate source check. The named father may be [[Glasgow-3457|Robert Glasgow]], but identifying that adult profile remains possible rather than proved. Mary Borland's identification and any parent attachment need separate review.
